description: TypeScript interface defining encryption provider methods for encryption/decryption, key management, and related operations in the encryption domain.

methods.name: encryptSplitSingle
methods.description: Encrypts a single data split and returns an encrypted payload.

methods.name: encryptSplit
methods.description: Encrypts multiple data splits and returns an array of encrypted payloads.

methods.name: decryptSplitSingle
methods.description: Decrypts a single data split, returning either decrypted data or encrypted payload.

methods.name: decryptSplit
methods.description: Decrypts multiple data splits, returning an array of decrypted data or encrypted payloads.

methods.name: hasRootKeyEncryptionSource
methods.description: Checks if there is a root key encryption source.

methods.name: getKeyEmbeddedKeyParams
methods.description: Retrieves embedded key parameters from an encrypted payload.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Computes the root key from a password and key parameters.

methods.name: supportedVersions
methods.description: Returns supported protocol versions.

methods.name: isVersionNewerThanLibraryVersion
methods.description: Checks if a version is newer than the library version.

methods.name: platformSupportsKeyDerivation
methods.description: Checks if platform supports key derivation with given parameters.

methods.name: computeWrappingKey
methods.description: Computes a wrapping key from a passcode.

methods.name: getUserVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the user protocol version.

methods.name: decryptBackupFile
methods.description: Decrypts a backup file, optionally with a password.

methods.name: hasAccount
methods.description: Checks if an account exists.

methods.name: decryptErroredPayloads
methods.description: Decrypts payloads that previously encountered errors.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceSpecificKeyStateFromDevice
methods.description: Deletes workspace-specific key state from device.

methods.name: hasPasscode
methods.description: Checks if a passcode is set.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a new root key with given identifier, password, origination, and optional version.

methods.name: setNewRootKeyWrapper
methods.description: Sets a new root key wrapper.

methods.name: removePasscode
methods.description: Removes the passcode.

methods.name: validateAccountPassword
methods.description: Validates the account password, returning validity and artifacts.

methods.name: createNewItemsKeyWithRollback
methods.description: Creates a new items key with rollback capability.

methods.name: reencryptItemsKeys
methods.description: Re-encrypts items keys.

methods.name: getSureDefaultItemsKey
methods.description: Retrieves the default items key.

methods.name: getRootKeyParams
methods.description: Retrieves root key parameters.

methods.name: getEmbeddedPayloadAuthenticatedData
methods.description: Gets embedded authenticated data from a payload.
